data.title: ONE Championship: Akimoto camp alleges illegal knees in Haggerty title defeat
data.description: Japanese challenger Hiroki Akimoto’s camp has renewed its call for a review of his ONE Championship defeat by British champion Jonathan Haggerty, alleging that two illegal knee attacks went unpunished.

data.title: ONE Championship: Nabil challenges Yoza to Muay Thai after ‘boring’ criticism
data.description: Nabil Anane has challenged Yuki Yoza to face him under Muay Thai rules after the Japanese striker criticised their ONE Samurai 4 contest as boring.

data.title: Sharks still in search of first victory
data.description: Chonburi remain without a win this season after a 2-1 home defeat by PT Prachuap in Thai League 1 on Saturday night, despite a change of head coach.

data.title: ONE Championship: Chatri mocks Anpo with heavyweight jibe after hydration row
data.description: Chatri Sityodtong has hit back at Rukiya Anpo’s criticism of ONE Championship’s hydration testing, telling the Japanese kickboxer to take responsibility – and joking that he should fight at heavyweight.

data.title: ONE Championship: Haggerty explains US$100,000 Akimoto finish – ‘Do I start kneeing now?’
data.description: British champion Jonathan Haggerty asked his corner whether it was time to start kneeing Hiroki Akimoto – then delivered a third-round finish that earned him a US$100,000 bonus at ONE Samurai 4.

data.title: ONE Championship: Noiri rules out December Grigorian final after revealing injury
data.description: Masaaki Noiri has ruled out facing Marat Grigorian in December after revealing he fought through an injury to reach ONE Championship’s featherweight kickboxing tournament final.

data.title: Lamphun break winless run as Ayutthaya slump at their home
data.description: Lamphun Warriors picked up their first win of the season when they defeated Ayutthaya United 2-0 in the Thai League 1 at Ayutthaya Stadium on Friday night.

data.title: Pornpawee and doubles duo fall in Denmark
data.description: Pornpawee Chochuwong and the men's doubles pair Peeratchai Sukphun/Pakkapon Teeraratsakul bowed out in the quarter-finals of the US$950,000 BWF Denmark Open in Odense on Friday, ending Thai interest in the Super 750 event.

data.title: Haaland stars in Man City win, Liverpool beat Brentford
data.description: LONDON - Erling Haaland starred with a double as Premier League leaders Manchester City beat Ipswich 3-2, while Liverpool came from behind to seal a 2-1 win at Brentford on Saturday.

data.title: ONE Championship: Johan Ghazali open to Ondash rematch after settling Paez score
data.description: Johan Ghazali has left the door open to another fight with Ramadan Ondash in ONE Championship after avenging his defeat by Diego Paez – while reviving his complaint about the Lebanese fighter’s mouthguard.

data.title: ONE Championship: Rukiya Anpo says Samurai 4 fight is off after ninth failed hydration test
data.description: Rukiya Anpo says his fight against Bogdan Shumarov is off ONE Samurai 4 after a ninth failed hydration test on Saturday morning, leaving the Tokyo event without two of its highest-profile kickboxing bouts.

data.title: ONE Championship: Marat Grigorian into final after Luo Chao’s 9.4lb miss – ‘he just didn’t care’
data.description: Marat Grigorian has advanced to the ONE Samurai featherweight kickboxing tournament final after Luo Chao’s extraordinary 9.4lb weight miss, accusing his opponent of failing to take the cut seriously.

data.title: Haze triggers highest-level alert in parts of Southeast Asia
data.description: SINGAPORE - Fires in Indonesia that have sent toxic smoke disrupting daily life across Southeast Asia has triggered the highest-level alert by the regional bloc’s meteorological monitor.

data.title: Choi holds firm, Jeeno trails by four
data.description: SHANGHAI: Choi Hye-Jin maintained a two-stroke lead after the second round of the LPGA Shanghai tournament yesterday, while defending champion Jeeno Thitikul was four shots off the pace.

data.title: Leaders Manchester City's progress comes with an asterisk
data.description: There is a rather strange atmosphere in the Premier League at the moment as a direct result of the Manchester City situation. It is a period of uncertainty which is likely to continue until we know the outcome of City's appeal against financial malfeasance. It gets even foggier with the Citizens sitting on top of the table and looking like one of the strongest candidates for the title.

data.title: Asia's elite players vie for AFC honours in Bangkok
data.description: The Asian Football Confederation (AFC) yesterday unveiled a list of nominees for the AFC Awards Bangkok 2026, which is slated to take place on Nov 19.

data.title: Norasetthada smashes national record
data.description: Thailand's Norasetthada Bunma broke the national record for the men's 1km time trial at the UCI Track World Championships in Shanghai yesterday, clocking one minute 2.987 seconds to finish 24th in a field of 30.

data.title: Pathum sunk at home as Adelaide snatch winner
data.description: BG Pathum United remain winless in the AFC Champions League Two after they went down at home to Adelaide United 2-1 at Pathum Thani Stadium on Thursday night.

data.title: ONE Championship: Grigorian–Luo bout in doubt after Samurai 4 weigh-in failures
data.description: Marat Grigorian’s ONE Samurai featherweight kickboxing tournament semi-final against Luo Chao appears unlikely to go ahead after neither fighter appeared at Friday evening’s face-offs in Tokyo.

data.title: Dechapol, Supissara out of Denmark Open
data.description: Mixed doubles players Dechapol Puavaranukroh and Supissara Paewsampran bowed out in the last 16 of the US$950,000 BWF Denmark Open on Thursday.

data.title: Man Utd teetering towards crisis as Man City cloud hangs over Premier League
data.description: MANCHESTER - Manchester United travel to historic rivals Leeds on Sunday with pressure mounting on manager Michael Carrick, while Manchester City aim to extend their perfect Premier League start despite the uncertainty over their future.

data.title: Lyon down Palace in Europa League, Sunderland leave it late
data.description: PARIS - French club Lyon held off Crystal Palace 3-2 in the Europa League on Thursday, while Sunderland made a late comeback to break the hearts of Portuguese second-division side Torreense.

data.title: Kashiwa hit five in 30 minutes to sink Port
data.description: Port suffered a heavy away defeat as they lost 5-1 to Japan's Kashiwa Reysol in the AFC Champions League Elite on Wednesday night.

data.title: Thai sprinters set national record as LA push begins
data.description: Thailand's team sprint squad broke the national record at the UCI Track World Championships in Shanghai, finishing 13th overall and third best in Asia as the country opened its qualification campaign for the 2028 Olympic Games.

data.title: ONE Championship: Prajanchai makes weight for Wang clash as Aliff waits
data.description: Prajanchai Pongsuphan PK cleared the scales for his first ONE Championship fight in more than a year on Thursday, setting up a kickboxing comeback he hopes will prepare him for a long-awaited Muay Thai title unification bout with Aliff Sor Dechapan.

data.title: Tempest in a go-kart as engine debate turns mean
data.description: Children have been caught in the crosshairs of a controversy that arose after a go-karting race in Chon Buri, prompting the body that governs the sport to urge those making comments to leave the young racers out of it.

data.title: ‘High hopes’ as Indonesian women’s football league returns
data.description: JAKARTA - Seven years after Covid-19 put the brakes on Indonesia’s new women’s football league, Zahra Naqiyyah will finally return to the field with “high hopes” for the women’s game in the country.

data.title: PSG beat Man City in Champions League thriller, Barcola hits Liverpool hat-trick
data.description: PARIS (FRANCE) - Reigning champions Paris Saint-Germain romped to a 4-2 victory away to embattled Manchester City in the UEFA Champions League on Wednesday, while Bradley Barcola hit his first Liverpool goals with a hat-trick in a 6-3 win over LASK in Austria.

data.title: T1 clubs sustain defeats in ACL Elite duels
data.description: It was a bleak Tuesday night for Thailand in the AFC Champions League Elite, with Ratchaburi and Buriram United each beaten 1-0 by goals from substitutes.

data.title: Jakkarin flies the flag for Kingdom
data.description: Jakkarin Dammunee has been named a flag bearer for the Thai contingent during the opening ceremony of the 5th Asian Para Games, which will take place in Aichi-Nagoya, Japan, next week.

data.title: Thai hopes suffer double Odense blow
data.description: Two Thai mixed doubles pairs bowed out in the first round of the US$950,000 BWF Denmark Open in Odense on Wednesday, a day after men's top seed Kunlavut Vitidsarn suffered a shock early exit.

data.title: ONE Championship: Haggerty eyes Muay Thai title return ahead of Akimoto defence
data.description: British champion Jonathan Haggerty wants to reclaim ONE Championship’s bantamweight Muay Thai title if he comes through Saturday’s kickboxing defence against Japanese challenger Hiroki Akimoto in Tokyo.

data.title: ONE Championship: Rifdean ‘101 per cent’ confident of Nadaka knockout in Tokyo title bid
data.description: Malaysian challenger Rifdean Masdor says he is “101 per cent” confident of knocking out Nadaka Yoshinari when he bids to end the Japanese champion’s seven-year unbeaten run and take his ONE Championship atomweight Muay Thai world title on Saturday.

data.title: Regulator 'will resign' if any political interference in Man City case
data.description: MANCHESTER (UNITED KINGDOM) - The chair of English football's Independent Regulator has said he will resign if there is political interference in any future investigation into Manchester City as a result of widespread impropriety.

data.title: Pat Bradley: A lovely swing to remember
data.description: The swing that God gave Pat Bradley was a thing of beauty. It was a lovely rhythmic motion that never seemed to change, whatever club she was using. I found her practising at the Florida club she called home at the time. After a while, she spotted me watching her go through her practice routine and said hello, she caught my English accent and asked me many questions. I had always wanted to meet her as I had admired her swing ever since I saw it on TV.
